    Use Your FSA or HSA Funds on CurrentBody

    With a Flexible Spending Account (FSA) or Health Savings Account (HSA), you can use pre-tax money to cover qualified wellness products – including select items on CurrentBody. For some specialized products, an additional step is needed: a Letter of Medical Necessity (LOMN) to qualify.

    How It Works

    1. How It Works with a Letter of Medical Necessity
    2. Add the product to your basket and head to checkout.
    3. Choose ‘Flex | Pay with HSA/FSA’ and click ‘Pay Now’.
    4. Fill out the form with your FSA/HSA details.
    5. Flex will send you a LOMN (if eligible) within 24 hours via email – your letter is valid for 12 months, making future purchases even simpler!

    Empower your wellness journey with ease and savings by tapping into your FSA/HSA. Our qualified products are here to help you feel and look your best – effortlessly.

        Clinic-trusted RF technology, skin tightening results

        When it comes to non-invasive skin tightening, radio frequency (RF) technology is definitely the go-to choice for clinics. Radio frequency boosts collagen production by delivering just the right amount of heat to the deeper layers of your skin. The CurrentBody Skin Radio Frequency Device brings this skin tightening tech to your home. Our RF Device uses radio frequency waves to heat the skin up to 104°F for effective collagen remodelling, giving you visibly tighter, plumper skin.

        RF skin tightening is the clinically acclaimed answer to tightening sagging skin on the face and neck; 89% saw an improvement in skin tightness (elasticity) in just 8 weeks.

        Safe and effective radio frequency skin tightening.

        The RF Device uses our exclusive tech for safe and effective radio frequency treatments from home. Our exclusive Skin Sense Technology continuously measures skin temperature and automatically adjusts to your skin’s resistance to keep skin at 104°F, the optimal temperature for maximum collagen production. This allows for safe, effective at-home treatments.

        Your questions, answered

        Our in-house beauty tech answers your most commonly asked questions.

        Step 1: Remove all jewelry from the treatment area, before applying a liberal layer of gel to clean, dry skin.

        Step 2: Plug in the mains power cable, turn on your device, then touch all 4 metal probes to your skin.

        Step 3: Once the green light starts blinking, move the device slowly over your treatment area.

        Step 4: After 5 minutes, the light will turn orange signaling that it’s time to move onto the next area.

        Step 5: Rinse away any excess gel and continue with your skincare regimen.

        Expert Advice: Use once a week for 8 weeks, then treatments can be topped every 4 to 8 weeks to maintain long-term results.

        Yes. You must pair with the CurrentBody Skin Radio Frequency Gel before every radio frequency facial to conducting radio frequency energy waves, and maximize results.

        If your orange light takes longer than 5 minutes or if you don't feel heat from your device, try the following:

        Slow down your movements

        Try a smaller treatment area

        Remove any excess gel

        We recommend following ’The Full Face’ skin tightening treatment to address everything; from fading forehead lines and crow’s feet, to sculpting your cheekbones and jawline. It only takes 70 minutes (5 minutes per treatment area).

        The CurrentBody Skin RF Device is completely safe, having been clinically proven, science and dermatologist backed. You may feel a warming sensation or experience some mild redness, but both are completely normal just after treatment.

        There is a stop/start safety feature which in case of loss of skin contact, there is an instantaneous disconnection (within 32ms) to ensure no discomfort when starting and ending therapy.

        We don’t recommend using the device if you have highly sensitive or damaged skin, sunburn or over tattoos.

        The CurrentBody Skin RF home-use device gives the freedom and convenience to treat skin concerns with a portable handheld device that can be used from anywhere—without the need for a clinician or bulky machine.

        No, the CurrentBody Skin RF Device will not cause fat loss in the face. Here's why:

        It doesn't heat deep enough. Fat reduction requires heating the deeper layers of tissue to around 113°F for several minutes. This device is designed to reach a maximum of 104°F on the skin’s surface, which is both safe and comfortable.

        It targets the skin, not fat. The device works within the dermis, the middle layer of your skin, to support skin rejuvenation. It does not reach the deeper fat layers where fat loss would occur.

        It focuses on skin tightening. The gentle heat stimulates fibroblasts to boost collagen production, helping to firm and lift the skin. It is not designed to damage or shrink fat cells.

        In short, this device helps improve skin texture and tone without affecting facial fat.

        DO NOT use if you have an implanted pacemaker, arrhythmias, or any other severe known heart disorder.

        DO NOT use if you have any active or silicone implants, any implantable metal device, or body piercing in the treatment area.

        DO NOT use if you have any blood clotting disorders; a history of deep vein thrombosis, collagen disorders, or keloid scarring; suffer from excessive bleeding, bruising, or damaged wound healing; or are taking blood thinning medications.

        DO NOT use if you have a history of skin cancer or areas of potential skin malignancies. Use of the device has not been tested in areas with skin cancer and therefore the effects are unknown.

        DO NOT use if you had injected chemical materials (such as Botox or fillers), or plastic surgery (such as face lifting, eyelid surgery) in the treatment area within the past 3 months.

        DO NOT use if you have had a professional chemical peel, a professional facial abrasion, or ablative laser treatments within the past 3 months.

        DO NOT use if you are pregnant, intend to become pregnant, or are breastfeeding.

        DO NOT use if you have experienced a migraine in the last two years.

        DO NOT use if you suffer from severe or uncontrolled endocrine or metabolic conditions, such as diabetes or uncontrolled thyroid disease.

        DO NOT use if you have a damaged immune system or autoimmune disorder, such as AIDS or Lupus, or if you use drugs that influence the immune system.

        DO NOT use if you have a general extreme illness, such as hepatitis, liver disease, or epilepsy.

        DO NOT use if you have diminished or exaggerated perception of temperature change.

        DO NOT use if you have taken retinoids within the past 6 months.

        DO NOT use over tattoos.

        Certification: UKCA registered

        Frequency: 1±0.05[MHz]

        Power Levels: 1 level

        Temperature Sensors: RF heating is automatically deactivated when skin reaches 40-41°C. The heating is reactivated when temperature decreases

        Treatment Area: ~2.2cm² / 0.34in²

        External Power Supply: Input 100-240VAC, 50-60Hz, Output 9VDC, 1.5A

        Device Size and Weight: 96g, 145mm x 45mm x 42mm 3.4oz, 5.7in x 1.7in x 1.7in
